主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada filed two legal opinions related to its issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series F, denominated in U.S. dollars. The opinions were provided by Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP, addressing Canadian, Ontario, Quebec, and New York law matters. The filing was made under the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-189888).
